interpretation: Prediction residual is supplied prediction minus measured observation after the declared unit conversion.
The evaluation window is start-inclusive and end-exclusive; all timestamps retain their original lexemes.
No interpolation, hold-forward, averaging, extrapolation or energy-savings attribution is performed.
Nearest alignment is bounded, rejects equal-distance ambiguity and never reuses an observation within a run/point.
Coverage and all skipped/invalid/duplicate occurrences stay visible. Missing readings are not zero.
Metric values use exact rational arithmetic; RMSE is separately labelled a floating square-root approximation.
Thresholds are user-supplied review limits, not engineering operating limits or authority to act.
